GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 7 lengths. moved up Wide turn 4 lengths. loomed up 200 metres. peaked late # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat rail 7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, joined in passing 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on well # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that the mare did not appreciate the tight-turning course. Passing the 50m, rider was struck by the whip of the rider of another horse, which caused him to desist riding his mount out with full vigour from that point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. got to outside 300 metres. ran on well # too strong
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn 5 lengths. ran on strongly between runners. copped check 100 metres # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped soon after the start. Passing the 100m was hampered and obliged to ease. Protest against 3rd upheld.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Not pushed early & raced 4th on rail (3.5L from lead). Stayed same until improving on inside @ 500m. Pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pushed along Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 200m & outsprinted in last 150m. # Every Chance
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 6 lengths. well back turn. got to outside 300 metres. ran on strongly # start no help
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 10 lengths. last turn looking for run. ran on well in Straight # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping made contact with rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , scrubbed along 3rd last Two Wide 10 Lengths 800m, only battled between runners last 200m # battled last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 350m had to be restrained when crowded from its rightful running and was taken out on to the hindquarter of a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: was a Bit Slow Out and Settled Down Clear last. Settled Down Two Wide at tail Just 3.5 Lengths @ 700m. to 4th on Straightening Up than simply couldn't quicken when asked, Gradually Gave Ground , back to last again in the end. 1st 2 out 1st 2 home - two clear faves # No Match at all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered after the 600m and again rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 5 lengths. 4th turn 3 lengths. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Improved 3 Wide Mid Field No Cover 5l. Ridden Along Turn . Straightened Up Same margin Under Pressure . Held Ground before tired final 100m # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.
